description.fallback: Sasuke fights his way back to the institute against the flying dinosaurs with Menō's help. He notices the Titan's emergence, and recalling that Zansūru brought up Sasuke having an ally, Sasuke realises Jiji is Zansūru's accomplice, the only other person who knew he wasn't working alone. Zansūru thinks the Prime Minister will be pleased by the assets.
